say:0:1122108001:0.text: Capturing a terrabird... This job seems easy-peasy!
say:0:1122108001:0.source_cn: 抓陆行鸟……果然是和找猫遛狗差不多的委托。

say:1:1122108002:0.text: Even super duper easy jobs like this are given to bounty hunters! And Chippy thought that Wildclaw might've been lying.
say:1:1122108002:0.source_cn: 原来这么简单的事也会找赏金猎人来做啊，满满还以为烈爪说...

say:2:1122108003:0.text: First, let's go back and tell Silverbeak the details.
say:2:1122108003:0.source_cn: 先把具体的委托内容告诉银喙吧。
